question: Will Mike Winkelmann (Beeple) post about $LAPTOP by September 30?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the specified person posts a qualifying textual reference to Hunter Biden's Laptop memecoin ($LAPTOP) on their accounts listed below between the creation of this market and September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The relevant accounts are:

Donald Trump:  X - @realDonaldTrump; Truth Social - @realDonaldTrump
Elon Musk: X - @elonmusk
Donald Trump Jr.: X - @DonaldJTrumpJr; Truth Social- @DonaldJTrumpJr
Eric Trump: X - @EricTrump; Truth Social - @EricTrump
Changpeng Zhao (CZ): X- @cz_binance
Mike Winkelmann (Beeple): X - @beeple

To qualify, a post's text must clearly refer to Hunter Biden's Laptop memecoin through language such as "Laptop Coin", "Laptop Token", "$Laptop", "Hunter Biden's New Coin", or an equivalently clear reference to the token. The word "laptop" alone, without context that clearly identifies the token, will not qualify. References solely to Hunter Biden's physical laptop, the Hunter Biden laptop controversy, its contents, related investigations, or any associated political events will not alone qualify.

For the purposes of this market, all text posted by such accounts in main feed posts, quote posts, and reply posts counts toward a "Yes" resolution, but text within quoted posts and reposts will not count.

Text posted in images, memes, or other non-animated, non-video media that are not strictly text will qualify toward a "Yes" resolution only if a qualifying reference appears in text within the content (e.g., "$LAPTOP" spelled out in a letter posted as a .jpg will qualify; a reference appearing only within an animated .gif or video will not). Words spoken aloud in videos, livestreams, or audio content will not count toward a "Yes" resolution; only posted text qualifies.

Posts published from an account during a period in which the account is verifiably compromised or hacked, as confirmed by the account owner or the platform, do not qualify.

The resolution source for this market will be X & Truth Social, specifically the account pages for the listed accounts.

question: LAPTOP airdrop by September 9?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if an airdrop of LAPTOP tokens is performed by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The token referenced in this market is LAPTOP, the token announced by Hunter Biden for launch on Base, as identified by the token's official channels (https://x.com/Laptoptoken) and confirmed by Hunter Biden or his official representatives.

An airdrop qualifies if LAPTOP tokens are distributed to, or made claimable by, eligible third-party wallets free of charge; a distribution limited to a specific community, such as holders of the TRUMP token, will qualify. Allocations to founders, team members, or other insiders will not qualify as an airdrop. For the purposes of this market, "locked" tokens or non-swappable tokens will not suffice to resolve this market to "Yes". Airdrops of NFTs or of tokens other than LAPTOP will not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market is on-chain information and official information from Hunter Biden or the LAPTOP token's official channels, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

question: Will AfD win 50 or more seats in the 2026 Sachsen-Anhalt parliamentary elections?
description:
Parliamentary elections to elect the Landtag of Sachsen-Anhalt are scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the number of seats won by the AfD party in the Landtag of Sachsen-Anhalt as a result of this election.

If the AfD party contests this election as part of a joint candidate list with one or more parties, all seats won by the joint candidate list will be counted. If the AfD party merges with another party prior to the election, all seats won by the resultant merged party, or any joint candidate list through which it contests the election, will be counted.

If the results of this election are not definitively known by September 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the AfD party in this election.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as published on the official website of the Landtag of Sachsen-Anhalt (https://www.landtag.sachsen-anhalt.de/).

question: Map Handicap: MIBR (-1.5) vs 9z (+1.5)
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Upper bracket semifinal 1 match between 9z and MIBR in the FISSURE PLAYGROUND Group A, initially scheduled for September 9, 2026 at 1:50 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "MIBR" if MIBR wins 2 or more maps than 9z in this match.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "9z". 

Maps won by forfeit, disqualification, walkover, or default are counted towards the handicap, provided that the match is completed.

If the match is canceled (not played at all for any reason) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before September 23, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of September 9, 2026 at 1:50 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's match forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match ends due to the clinching map being forfeited this will count as a completed match.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

question: Will there be a red flag during the 2026 F1 Dutch Grand Prix?
description:

The resolution source will be the official Formula 1 website and a consensus of credible sports news reporting.

question: Over $37.5M committed to the RipCars public sale?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if total commitments for the RipCars raise on MetaDAO exceeds the number specified in the title before the raise closes. Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is the “committed” figure displayed on the official RipCars sale page at https://www.metadao.fi/projects/ripcars/fundraise. If the displayed figure reaches the threshold at any point before August 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Yes" regardless of subsequent refunds or cancellations. If the sale is on hold and no commitment total is verifiable by August 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or if the raise event is otherwise cancelled or rescheduled to a time past that date, this market resolves to "No". If requisite information for this market’s resolution becomes permanently unavailable within this market’s timeframe, this market will resolve to “No”.

If the sale begins and is extended before the official closing time, commitments made during the extended period will count toward resolution.
